cases.prompt: Make me a 10-question multiple-choice quiz about photosynthesis for a high-school biology test. Show one question at a time, tell me right away whether my answer was correct with a one-line explanation, and show my score at the end.

I have a chemistry exam on acids and bases. Build an exam-prep quiz with 8 multiple-choice questions, a 5-minute countdown timer, and at the end a review screen that lists only the questions I got wrong with the correct answers.

Create flashcards for 12 common Spanish verbs (infinitive on the front, English meaning and the yo-form on the back). Let me mark each card as known or not known and remember my progress between visits.
Build a short practice tool with 3 open questions about the causes of the First World War. I type my answer in a text box and an AI grades it from 0 to 10 with one sentence of feedback.

Turn this CSV into an interactive bar chart as a React component with a tooltip on hover:
month,visitors
Jan,1200
Feb,1350
Mar,1610
Apr,1480
May,1720
Jun,1905
Draw a Mermaid flowchart of how a library book is borrowed and returned, including the late-return branch.
Write a one-page study guide in Markdown on the water cycle: key terms, the four stages, and five self-check questions with answers at the end.
Make a one-page cheat sheet of the Git commands I use every day, grouped into setup, everyday work, branches and undoing mistakes, with a one-line explanation for each command.
Make an SVG diagram of an animal cell with labels for the nucleus, mitochondria, cell membrane, ribosomes and the endoplasmic reticulum.
Make a 5-question multiple-choice quiz about the planets of the solar system with a score at the end.
How do I reverse a string in Python? Just the one-liner, please.
Зроби тест з 6 запитань з варіантами відповідей про історію Києва. Після кожної відповіді покажи, чи вона правильна, а наприкінці — мій результат.
Build a trivia quiz that loads its questions from the Open Trivia DB API (https://opentdb.com/api.php?amount=5) and has a button that opens the Open Trivia DB website so I can find more quizzes.
